verdict.rationale: Dispute handling is a fair axis for a payments platform, but the evidence pack never documents a chargeback or dispute API for retrieving disputes, attaching evidence, or submitting responses. The MCP server covers documentation search, test users and webhooks. The CLI covers payments, preferences, subscriptions, stores and reports, with no dispute management. Community threads about consumer-side prepaid card disputes do not describe any merchant API capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent handle a dispute end-to-end, retrieving it, assembling evidence, and submitting the response via the API
